exam.sourceNote: 題目依使用者提供之《國中英文 全民英檢攻略 全》第四回實體書照片校正版建立，原書 p.27–34，共 35 題。未提供官方答案頁；答案依文法、語意與文章內容判讀。Q26 與 Q34 已接入圖片選項。

questions.q: “The _____ is always right” is a slogan we often hear. Be nice to them, so they’ll visit our store again!
questions.e: 答案是 (B) customer。The customer is always right 是常見說法，意為『顧客永遠是對的』。

questions.q: Wendy is _____ late. I wonder why she hasn’t showed up.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) seldom。seldom late 表示『很少遲到』。

questions.q: Don’t _____ too much on Jerry. After all, he’s a guy that’s lied many times.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) expect。句意為不要對 Jerry 期待太多；較自然的英文通常寫 expect too much from Jerry。

questions.q: The muffins in that newly-opened bakery are too _____ to miss.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) tasty。too tasty to miss 表示『太美味了，不能錯過』。

questions.q: You could _____ more sugar if you do think your coffee is not sweet enough.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) ask for。ask for more sugar 是『再要一些糖』。

questions.q: The students are always asked to _____ the rules, or they’ll be seriously punished.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) obey。obey the rules 表示遵守規則。

questions.q: The concert tonight was _____ — everyone stood up and shouted “encore!”
questions.e: 答案是 (A) terrific。大家起立高喊 encore，表示表演非常精彩。

questions.q: You mustn’t park your car along this street. If you do, your car will be _____.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) towed away，表示車子被拖吊。

questions.q: _____ overtime every day, Ted can make some extra money to afford his new car.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) By working。by + V-ing 表示藉由某種方式。

questions.q: Let’s _____ talk loud to make the train a quieter place.
questions.e: 答案是 (D) not。Let’s not + 原形動詞表示『我們不要……』。

questions.q: Neither my parents nor Peter _____ going to attend my graduation ceremony.
questions.e: 答案是 (B) is。neither A nor B 的動詞通常與較靠近的主詞 B 一致；Peter 為單數。

questions.q: Aaron used to _____ a lot, which made his heart disease worse.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) smoke。used to + 原形動詞。

questions.q: The students were told the truth that turning off the lights before leaving _____ quite important.
questions.e: 答案是 (A) was。turning off the lights 為動名詞片語作主詞，視為單數。

questions.q: Sarah got lots of cards and flowers as soon as she _____ into her office.
questions.e: 答案是 (C) stepped。主句 got 為過去式，同一過去事件用 stepped。

questions.q: Patricia says she’ll never forget Paris, _____ she met her “Mr. Right.”
questions.e: 答案是 (D) where。Paris 是地點，where 表示『在那裡』。

questions.intro:
Last Sunday my parents took me to the Taipei City Zoo. We got up __16__ than we usually do, but __17__ the heavy rain and traffic, we still got there late.

__18__ the animals, I love the koalas most, so we visited them first. How cute the koala baby looked! At the koala house, we heard they had just been voted as the most popular animals in the zoo. We all felt happy for them. Next, we visited the pandas as we __19__.

We stayed at the zoo __20__ it got dark, and then we all took Mao-kong Gondola. We had dinner in the mountains and enjoyed the night view of Taipei before going home.
questions.q: 第 16 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (C) earlier。後面有 than，要用比較級。

questions.q: 第 17 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (C) because of。後面接名詞片語 the heavy rain and traffic。

questions.q: 第 18 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (D) Of all。Of all the animals 表示『在所有動物之中』。

questions.q: 第 19 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (D) had planned。規劃發生在 visited 之前，用過去完成式。

questions.q: 第 20 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (C) until。stayed at the zoo until it got dark 表示一直待到天黑。

questions.intro: Dad went to a __21__ the other day. When he came back, he told Mom __22__ he wanted to change his name. He said he would have very bad __23__ if he did not do this. Mom was surprised __24__ that. She began to comfort my dad by saying that happiness of life should be in his own control. She even said that she liked my dad partly because she liked his name. After hearing her words, Dad found he was wrong and said he would keep __25__ his name forever.
questions.q: 第 21 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (B) fortune teller。後文談改名字與運氣，符合算命師。

questions.q: 第 22 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (D) that。told Mom that... 為受詞子句。

questions.q: 第 23 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (C) luck。bad luck 是『壞運氣』。

questions.q: 第 24 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (C) to hear。be surprised to hear... 是常用句型。

questions.q: 第 25 空應填入哪一個選項？
questions.e: 答案是 (D) using。keep + V-ing。原書 (B)、(C) 皆印為 to use，依原頁保留。

questions.intro:
Gondola Ride
▶ Get a good view around the lake!
▶ Take you 60 meters above the ground.
▶ Enjoy the exciting moments with the glass bottom!

Time: 8:00 a.m. ~ 9:00 p.m. (every day except strong winds)
Time Needed: About 15 minutes
Number of People in a Car: Each gondola holds eight.
Price: $50 for adults
       $25 for kids under 12
       kids under 3 are free
questions.q: What may a gondola look like?
questions.e: 答案是 (D)。原書圖片選項依序為小船、吊橋、車輛與空中纜車車廂；本文描述的是空中 gondola。

questions.q: Which is true?
o: Six junior high students need to pay $150 to have a gondola ride.
Taking the gondola is exciting because you can see fish under the glass bottom.
People can have exciting moments in the gondola when there are typhoons.
It takes about fifteen minutes to go around the lake in a gondola.
questions.e: 答案是 (D)。廣告標示 Time Needed: About 15 minutes；強風時不營運，且沒有說玻璃底可看到魚。

questions.introLabel: Questions 28–29｜Kate 寫給 Mark 的信
questions.intro:
Dear Mark,

I know you’ve been practicing playing the piano hard these days. You may feel tired and sometimes even want to give up. We all know it’s not easy. In fact, learning to play a musical instrument is like learning a new language. You have to practice it a lot.

I used to have a piano teacher who was very strict when I was your age. She asked me to practice every day. After school, I didn’t have time to play with any other one. When I didn’t play well, she seemed disappointed. Then I practiced harder because I didn’t want to let her down.

Mr. Adams sounds like an excellent teacher. He cares about you and encourages you all the time. He wants you to be a great piano player, so he asks you to learn harder music. He must be very proud of you.

Kate
questions.q: What does disappointed mean in the reading?
questions.e: 答案是 (A) Down。disappointed 是失望、沮喪，down 最接近。

questions.q: Which is true in the reading?
o: Mr. Adams is Kate’s piano teacher.
Kate thanks her teacher for caring about her.
Mark’s teacher made him learn harder music.
Mark practices playing the piano very hard for his teacher.
questions.e: 答案是 (C)。文中說 Mr. Adams asks Mark to learn harder music。

questions.intro:
Beatrix Potter is a very famous artist in the world. Although she had little formal training in art when she was young, she was surprisingly good at it. She was famous for her drawing, and many of her drawings could be seen in children’s storybooks. Today, whenever a piece of work by the creator of Peter Rabbit goes for sale, the price gets higher.

Beatrix is known for the children’s books she wrote and drew, but few people know she could draw something else — she loved nature and was good at observing it. She saw the beautiful things in simple, like the fins of a fish. She could also make others see it by her drawing.

Her drawings of animals and plants look like real ones and show many facts about science. If she didn’t write children’s books, she’d become a famous illustrator in science.
questions.q: What kind of writer and illustrator do people know best about Beatrix Potter?
questions.e: 答案是 (C) Children’s books。文章直接說她以自己寫作並繪圖的童書聞名。

questions.q: What does observing mean in the reading?
questions.e: 答案是 (D) Notice。observe 在此為觀察、留意。

questions.q: What can we learn from the reading?
o: The work of the creator of Peter Rabbit is cheap.
Beatrix Potter started to learn drawing at an early age.
Beatrix Potter was able to show beautiful things to others.
Many people have known Beatrix Potter is good at drawing things about science.
questions.e: 答案是 (C)。文中說她可以透過畫作讓別人也看見自然中的美。

questions.intro:
Waste disposal is a serious problem in almost all cities. Some people may throw the garbage into the sea; others even burn it and bury it under the ground. Neither is good for the Earth and may lead to more pollution.

For people in Texas, it is not a problem at all. There are more than ten million workers working on it without pay. They never take vacations, ask for sick leave, or complain about working for long hours. These workers are earthworms.

To deal with waste disposal, people in Texas use earthworms. The earthworms eat the waste and turn it into clean fertilizer. Then they sell it to farmers. The city makes money from its waste, and this way costs far less than any other. Above all, it is environmentally better for the Earth.
questions.q: What is the reading mainly about?
questions.e: 答案是 (C) The waste disposal workers。全文重點在德州利用蚯蚓處理廢棄物。

questions.q: If a man often complains, what does he look like?
o: A sad man holding his hands near his chest
A worried man touching the side of his head
An angry man grumbling with a speech bubble
optionImageAlts: A distressed man touching his head
An angry man complaining with a speech bubble
questions.e: 答案是 (D)。complain 是『抱怨』；原書 (D) 圖為皺眉生氣並出現抱怨對話泡泡的人。

questions.q: What do people in Texas use earthworms for?
questions.e: 答案是 (B) Cleaning waste。蚯蚓吃掉廢棄物並把它轉成乾淨肥料。
